Class GTNetM2MExceptionAdvice

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.m2m.rest.GTNetM2MExceptionAdvice
@RestControllerAdvice(assignableTypes=GTNetM2MResource.class) public class GTNetM2MExceptionAdvice extends Object
Turns the failures that happen before GTNetM2MResource.receiveMessage(String, MessageEnvelope) is entered into the same protocol answer every other refusal uses.

A body that Jackson cannot bind — malformed JSON, a field of the wrong type, a truncated request — never reaches the controller method, so the envelope validator inside getMsgResponse cannot see it either. Left to the global error handler it would become an HTTP 400, and BaseDataClient maps every non-2xx to a result whose response envelope is null: the sending peer would record a failed delivery with no reason. Answering HTTP 200 with GNetCoreMessageCode.GT_NET_ERROR_S and ENVELOPE_INVALID keeps the reason readable.

Scoped to the one M2M controller so that ordinary /api/** error handling is untouched. The answer is built by hand rather than through the repository, because an error path must not need a database round trip; a null sourceGtNet is tolerated by the receiving side.
